scripts.api:free-port: sh -c 'pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:4000); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill -9 $pids; fi'
scripts.api:dev: npm run api:free-port && npm run --workspace @personal-finances/api dev
scripts.build: npm run --workspace @personal-finances/contracts build && npm run --workspace @personal-finances/api build && npm run --workspace @personal-finances/web build
scripts.dev: npm run --workspace @personal-finances/contracts build && npm run api:dev & npm run --workspace @personal-finances/web dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run --workspace @personal-finances/contracts build && npm run --workspaces --if-present typecheck
